The stopped response is a separate law-derived result; the fractional plant tests the decoder, not selection of a physical charge unit.

rows.result: A compact four-port charged ray has positive energy E6 = -1260 log(209/210) = 6.014331228348673 from the full 630-seam transfer operator of the same source; the disjoint pair has E12 = 12.057508280349891, which is 1024.4508487 keV in the unit fixed by 511 keV.
rows.scope: 511 keV sets the reporting unit and supplies no independent prediction. A transfer eigenray and its projector do not demonstrate source selection or unread-channel persistence. The separated-pair excess fails additive energy under this clock convention. Lower modes and pointer complements are retained.

rows.scope: These moment identities follow from equivariance and parity; the fixed-seam control breaks the relevant symmetry. They do not establish dynamical antipodal identification or a coherent full-turn sign. No spin or exchange claim follows.
